# Machine Learning

> Korean-language course materials from Pusan National University: lecture slides (PDF), interactive topic pages, and concept-check problem sets.

Instructor: [YongKyung Oh](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/people/)

## Lectures

- [What a Model Learns](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/lecture/00.%20Intro.pdf) (PDF)
- [Learning from Data](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/lecture/01.%20Learning%20from%20Data.pdf) (PDF): [Statistical Learning](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/01.%20learning-from-data/statistical-learning.html), [Learning Types](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/01.%20learning-from-data/learning-types.html), [Concept check: Data and Learning Types](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/problem-sets/data-and-learning-types.html)
- [Labels, Structure, Rewards](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/lecture/02.%20Labels%2C%20Structure%2C%20Rewards.pdf) (PDF): [Learning Problems](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/02.%20labels-structure-rewards/learning-problems.html), [Supervised Data](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/02.%20labels-structure-rewards/supervised-data.html), [Actions and Rewards](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/02.%20labels-structure-rewards/actions-and-rewards.html), [Concept check: Outputs, Structure, and Rewards](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/problem-sets/labels-structure-and-rewards.html)
- [Vectors and Matrices](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/lecture/03.%20Vectors%20and%20Matrices.pdf) (PDF): [Vectors](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/03.%20vectors-and-matrices/vectors.html), [Dot Products](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/03.%20vectors-and-matrices/dot-products.html), [Matrix Multiplication](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/03.%20vectors-and-matrices/matrix-multiplication.html), [Concept check: Vectors and Matrices](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/problem-sets/vectors-and-matrices.html)
- [Derivatives and Probability](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/lecture/04.%20Derivatives%20and%20Probability.pdf) (PDF): [Derivatives](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/04.%20derivatives-and-probability/derivatives.html), [Gradients](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/04.%20derivatives-and-probability/gradients.html), [Probability Distributions](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/04.%20derivatives-and-probability/probability-distributions.html), [Concept check: Derivatives and Probability](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/problem-sets/derivatives-and-probability.html)
- [Learning and Generalization](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/lecture/05.%20Learning%20and%20Generalization.pdf) (PDF): [Training and Test Data](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/05.%20learning-and-generalization/training-and-test-data.html), [Prediction Error](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/05.%20learning-and-generalization/prediction-error.html), [Model Complexity](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/05.%20learning-and-generalization/model-complexity.html), [Concept check: Learning and Generalization](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/problem-sets/learning-and-generalization.html)
- [Data Leakage](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/lecture/06.%20Data%20Leakage.pdf) (PDF): [Raw Data Preparation](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/06.%20data-leakage/raw-data-preparation.html), [Data Leakage](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/06.%20data-leakage/data-leakage.html), [Pipelines](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/06.%20data-leakage/pipelines.html), [Concept check: Data Leakage and Pipelines](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/problem-sets/data-leakage.html)
- [Linear Models](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/lecture/07.%20Linear%20Models.pdf) (PDF): [Linear Regression](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/07.%20linear-regression-revisited/linear-regression.html), [Least Squares](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/07.%20linear-regression-revisited/least-squares.html), [Concept check: Linear Models](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/problem-sets/linear-models.html)
- [Predicting a Probability](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/lecture/08.%20Predicting%20a%20Probability.pdf) (PDF): [Logistic Regression](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/08.%20predicting-a-probability/logistic-regression.html), [Probability to Decision](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/08.%20predicting-a-probability/probability-to-decision.html), [Concept check: Logistic Regression](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/problem-sets/logistic-regression.html)
- [Walking Downhill](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/lecture/09.%20Walking%20Downhill.pdf) (PDF): [Objective Functions](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/09.%20gradient-descent/objective-functions.html), [Gradient Descent](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/09.%20gradient-descent/gradient-descent.html), [Concept check: Gradient Descent](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/problem-sets/gradient-descent.html)
- [Fewer Examples per Step](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/lecture/10.%20Fewer%20Examples%20per%20Step.pdf) (PDF): [Stochastic Gradient Descent](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/10.%20stochastic-gradient-descent/stochastic-gradient-descent.html), [Mini-batches and Epochs](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/10.%20stochastic-gradient-descent/mini-batches-and-epochs.html), [Concept check: Stochastic Gradient Descent](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/problem-sets/stochastic-gradient-descent.html)
- [The Perceptron](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/lecture/11.%20The%20Perceptron.pdf) (PDF): [Perceptron Prediction](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/11.%20the-perceptron/perceptron-prediction.html), [Perceptron Learning Rule](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/11.%20the-perceptron/perceptron-learning-rule.html), [Concept check: Perceptrons](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/problem-sets/perceptron.html)
- [One Line Is Not Enough](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/lecture/12.%20One%20Line%20Is%20Not%20Enough.pdf) (PDF): [Linear Separability](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/12.%20linear-separability/linear-separability.html), [XOR](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/12.%20linear-separability/xor.html), [Concept check: Linear Separability](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/machine-learning/problem-sets/linear-separability.html)
